plan_ready.deterministicRule: Exactly one validated task uses execute_single; larger plans still require a decision. Dependency width alone is not proof of benefit.

modes.auto: Validated rule, then exact decision reuse, then Jev; dispatch one selected handler.
modes.force_jev: Bypass decision cache and deterministic rule; duplicate execution suppression still applies.

persistence: Process-local only. Do not resume side effects after restart without external reconciliation.
